description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter responsible for converting CSS length units between different measurement systems (English and Metric). It includes methods for unit conversion, handling precision, and external dependencies for arbitrary precision arithmetic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS length units, supporting different measurement systems and precision options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the unit converter with specified precision settings and whether to use BCMath.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length object from one unit to another, maintaining specified precision levels.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Calculates the number of significant figures in a numeric string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two numeric strings, with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies two numeric strings, with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two numeric strings, with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of significant figures.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a floating-point number to a specified number of decimal places, supporting both positive and negative scales.
